name: Siemens S7 Mock PLC
description: Lightweight Siemens S7 mock built with python-snap7. Seeds deterministic data blocks (DB1 motor telemetry, DB2 alarms), inputs, outputs and marker bytes, periodically mutated to mimic live plant data.
fidelity: mock PLC (DB/I/O/SZL-style behaviour; not a full S7-1500 emulator).

requirements.name: Python 3.10+
requirements.description: Required to run the mock device.

requirements.name: uv package manager
requirements.description: Required to install pinned dependencies and run the mock device.

fields.label: Listen Interface
fields.description: Bind address: localhost only, Lab Host network, or custom.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: TCP port for the mock device.

fields.label: Update Interval (s)
fields.description: How often the mock mutates simulated process values.

presets.name: Default PLC
presets.description: DB1 motor telemetry + DB2 alarms + toggling sensors.
